source_reviews.name: reveal_top_cards_of_library

source_reviews.name: card_raise_dead

strict_cfg_after.scope: Strict entry-reachable CFG comparison with exact unique COFF symbol identities and unchanged engine addresses and complete read-only C-string/DIALOG-token contents. Matched callees and globals remain identity/behavior assumptions; padding and direct jump trampolines are ignored. No whole-game or arbitrary callee equivalence claim.

compiled_verification.scope: One build after the complete source batch, then 30 focused checks with the unchanged strict comparator. Two match; 27 retain instruction differences and one has no unique full current COFF entry. No forced registers/stack allocation, gameplay proof or full reccmp refresh. C710 full-report scores remain historical C709 build results.

saved_value_notes: Raise Dead saves its grave pointer before validation; Farrels Mantle saves opponent life before get_power; token-copy and Glass Asp keep saved values across callbacks. These make native ordering explicit and do not claim the previous GCC build misordered the expressions. Six unsigned full-width bit masks in my_base_value remove signed-shift undefined behavior at bit 31 while preserving the native 32-bit tests.
